faq.question: Is this an Indian stock market news API?
faq.answer: Yes. It returns India equity headlines as structured JSON (API/dataset download) with links, NSE/BSE tickers, sentiment, and event tags—no custom scraper to maintain.

faq.question: Which Nifty and Sensex news sources are included?
faq.answer: Economic Times, Mint, Business Standard, Hindu Business Line, Moneycontrol, and NDTV Profit via the india_markets preset (up to 100 items, last 24 hours).

faq.question: Do I need to change any input before starting?
faq.answer: No. Click Start for the latest India stock market news API output as JSON. Duplicate and enable Only new articles to schedule alerts.

faq.question: Does output include NSE and BSE tickers?
faq.answer: Yes. Enrichment detects symbols and names (for example RELIANCE.NS) and attaches ticker and company details when available.
